2022 close of the Blumhouse Laurie trilogy.

How Halloween Ends connects

  • Topic: Halloween — Halloween Ends closes the 2018 Laurie trilogy.
  • Character: Laurie Strode — Halloween Ends finishes Laurie's late war with Michael.
  • Work: Halloween (2018) — The 2018 film leads into the trilogy that Ends closes.

What is Halloween Ends?

Halloween Ends concludes the 2018–2022 Laurie Strode cycle in Haddonfield, following the aftermath of Michael's return and a new copycat violence.

Key threads lead to Halloween, Laurie Strode and Halloween (2018).
